The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is used to blend many substances into solutions, usually for use in [[alchemy]].  A substance cannot be processed in the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} until it has been researched at the [[study table]] afterward it will list its decomposition products and anything which lists a fluid as one of its decomposition products can be processed in the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}.
